description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface to filter logs by passing only the message part downstream. It is used for on-screen log output where minimal metadata is desired.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that forwards only the message content to the next LogNode, skipping metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a specified next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message and passes it downstream with minimal data.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
